about: Running bug log. One object per bug; keep fixed bugs for reference. List open bugs: jq '.bugs[] | select(.fixed == false) | {id, title}' bugs_to_fix.json

bugs.title: Chart throws "Value is null" when reloading after a strategy switch
bugs.found_by: Strengthened dashboard browser test (tests/dashboard_ui_smoke.mjs) failed with 'Browser errors: Value is null'.
bugs.symptom: Browser console logged 'Uncaught Error: Value is null' one to three times. The chart still ended up drawn correctly, so users couldn't see it. It failed the browser test, which treats any browser error as a failure.
reproduce: Start the dashboard: ./start.command (or uv run python src/tradingview_mcp/ui/server.py).
Open it in Chrome with DevTools → Console open.
Click the Advanced tab. Pick resolution 12H and range 5Y.
Change the strategy dropdown to Bollinger, then back to Sloped Lines (this loads saved best parameters and resets the chart to 1D / 1Y).
Trigger any reload of the chart: click range 5Y, or the Regular tab.
'Value is null' appears in the console shortly after the reload.
bugs.reproduce_automated: npm run test:ui — its final step (click 5Y right after switching back to Sloped Lines) is this sequence and now guards against regression. Waiting before the click did not avoid the bug; it is not a click-timing issue.
bugs.cause: The main chart shares one time scale across the candles and every overlay line. updateDashboard() loaded the new candles first and removed the previous trendline/channel overlay series only later, after the new trendlines were fetched. Removing series after the swap shifted the shared time-scale positions under the new candles, so the library looked up bars at positions that no longer existed.
stack_traces: Error: Value is null at ensureNotNull ← TimeScale._internal_timeRangeForLogicalRange ← TimeScaleApi.getVisibleRange ← TimeScaleApi._private__onVisibleBarsChanged (visible-time-range event)
Error: Value is null at ensureNotNull ← SeriesBarColorer.Candlestick ← SeriesCandlesticksPaneView._internal__createRawItem (drawing a candle)
bugs.debug_tip: For readable stack traces, temporarily replace the bundled library with https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lightweight-charts@4.1.3/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.development.js
dead_ends: Switching the listener from subscribeVisibleTimeRangeChange to subscribeVisibleLogicalRangeChange removed the first trace but not the second. Not needed once the real cause was fixed; reverted.
Waiting (animation frames + 500 ms, up to 3 s) before the next click did not avoid the error.
bugs.fix: In updateDashboard(), remove the old trendline and channel overlay series before candlestickSeries.setData(...). New overlays are still added after the new candles. Side effect: during a reload the old lines vanish right away instead of staying until the new ones arrive.
bugs.verified: npm run test:ui passed 3/3 runs; 38/38 Python tests pass. On the Advanced tab, dragging and zooming the main chart still keeps the volume and RSI panels aligned (Playwright check, no browser errors).

bugs.title: Sloped trendlines can reactivate after crossing through price
bugs.found_by: AAPL 1Y / 1D chart review showed the descending resistance anchored on December 3 and December 26 crossing candle bodies before its January 27 breakout.
bugs.symptom: A trendline could visibly cut through one or more later candles, disappear as a valid candidate, then be selected again after price moved back to the other side. The chart also labeled the second anchor as the confirmation date even though a pivot becomes knowable only after the lookback bars complete.
reproduce: Open AAPL with the saved Sloped Lines configuration at 1D / 1Y.
Inspect the descending resistance beginning December 3, 2025 and anchored again December 26, 2025.
Observe candle bodies crossing the projected line after the second anchor before the line ends on January 27, 2026.
bugs.cause: Candidate validation checked candles only between the two anchors plus the current evaluation candle. It skipped every candle after anchor two and before the current candle, allowing an invalidated candidate to become valid again later. Swing points also discarded their actual confirmation bar, and the UI redrew only endpoint interpolation instead of the strategy's per-bar projection.
bugs.fix: Preserve each swing's actual confirmation bar; validate every candle from anchor one through the current bar; permit formation tolerance only before anchor two; invalidate on any selected body or wick touch after anchor two; use inclusive active-line breaks; and send one projected trendline value per candle to the UI.
bugs.verified: The former December 3 → December 26 → January 27 line no longer appears. AAPL now draws a clear December 3 → April 23 resistance, activates it after the April 30 pivot confirmation, and ends it May 1. 42 Python tests pass and the 19-case dashboard browser matrix passes across Regular/Advanced, 1D/4H/12H, and 3M/1Y/5Y.
bugs.performance_impact: For AAPL's saved 1Y / 1D parameters on data from 2025-09-26 through 2026-09-25, the corrected engine returns 15.83% across 4 trades with a 50.0% win rate. The stored 46.71% badge remains a historical baseline from the previous engine and requires re-optimization before replacement.
